solutions.title: Track visited node identities
solutions.strategy: Walk through next pointers while storing each node object already seen. Reaching a seen object proves a loop; reaching null proves the chain terminates.

timeComplexity.explanation: At most n distinct nodes are inspected before the walk either terminates or revisits a node.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The identity set can hold every reachable node in an acyclic list.

solutions.title: Floyd fast and slow pointers
solutions.strategy: Move one pointer by one hop and another by two hops. If a loop exists, the faster pointer eventually lands on the slower pointer inside the loop.

timeComplexity.explanation: The fast pointer can advance only a linear number of hops before either hitting null or meeting the slow pointer.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only two moving references are maintained regardless of list length.
